```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_csv("data/attendees_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(across(c(name_last, name_first), trimws)) |>
  arrange(name_last, name_first) |>
  mutate(
    display_name = paste0(
      name_last,
      ", ",
      name_first,
      ifelse(
        !is.na(name_middle) & name_middle != "",
        paste0(" ", name_middle),
        ""
      )
    ),
    affiliation = ifelse(is.na(affiliation), "", affiliation),
    display_name = gsub("&", "\\\\&", display_name),
    affiliation = gsub("&", "\\\\&", affiliation)
  )
```

\begin{center}

```{r}
#| output: asis
rows <- paste0(
  "$\\square$ & ",
  df$display_name,
  " & ",
  df$affiliation,
  " \\\\\n"
)

cat(
  "\\begin{longtable}{p{0.35cm} p{5.5cm} p{9cm}}\n",
  "\\toprule\n",
  " & \\textbf{Name} & \\textbf{Affiliation} \\\\\n",
  "\\midrule\n",
  "\\endhead\n",
  "\\midrule\n",
  "\\multicolumn{3}{r}{\\small\\textit{continued on next page}} \\\\\n",
  "\\endfoot\n",
  "\\bottomrule\n",
  "\\endlastfoot\n",
  paste(rows, collapse = ""),
  "\\end{longtable}\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
